info.title: RIMA IDENTITY API
info.description: RIMA IDENTITY API: This api is used to manage identity and authentication services.

post.summary: Login user. If email is not verified, a new verification email will be sent.
Service-to-service login using client credentials (confidential grant type).
Creates a new application with the provided details.

get.summary: Get a single application by its client ID.

put.summary: Updates an existing application identified by the provided ID with the new details.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the application to update.

get.summary: Gets the details of an application by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the application to retrieve.

delete.summary: Deletes an application identified by the provided ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the application to delete.

post.summary: Creates a new scope with the provided details.

requestBody.description: The details of the scope to create.

put.summary: Updates an existing scope identified by the provided ID with the new details.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the scope to update.

get.summary: Get the details of a scope by its ID. Returns the scope details if found, or appropriate error responses if not found or if an internal server error occurs.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the scope to retrieve.

delete.summary: Deletes a scope identified by the provided ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the scope to delete.

get.summary: Get all scopes associated with a specific application identified by the provided application ID.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: The ID of the application whose scopes are to be retrieved.

post.summary: Pin change process is a two-step process:
Complete the pin change process by validating the OTP and setting the new PIN. This is the second step of the pin change process.

get.summary: Test endpoint showing custom activity tracing
get.description:
This demonstrates distributed tracing with custom spans.
View traces in Seq (http://localhost:5341) or Grafana Cloud Tempo.

post.summary: Test endpoint showing nested spans (parent-child relationship)
post.description:
This demonstrates distributed tracing with nested operations.
Perfect for tracing multi-step authentication flows.

get.description: Logs will automatically include TraceId and SpanId for correlation.

post.description: Shows how traces and logs are automatically correlated via TraceId.

post.summary: Test endpoint to publish a message to test-topic
post.description:
This endpoint publishes a test message to Kafka test-topic.
Uses EF Core Outbox pattern for transactional messaging.
Message will be stored in database OutboxMessage table and delivered by background processor.
